title: docs(routing): add a routing guide
body:
This PR includes:

* the `routing` guide, [review it live](https://deploy-preview-2879--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/guides/routing.html)
* deprecation of the urlSync option via console.warn
* minor change to CONTRIBUTING for dev on examples
* routing for all examples (simple one)
* minor fix for no-results guide
